deficits.evidence: Dropped kerbs not visible at zebra crossing
deficits.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at both ends of the zebra crossing to ensure accessibility for pedestrians with disabilities and mobility aids.

deficits.evidence: Zebra crossing is obstructed by parked vehicles and not clearly visible to drivers
deficits.suggestion: Widen the zebra crossing and ensure it is free from obstructions by enforcing parking regulations and adding high-visibility markings.

deficits.evidence: Wide road with no refuge island in the middle of the crossing
deficits.suggestion: Introduce a refuge island in the middle of the crossing to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians crossing a wide road.

ratings.reason: The zebra crossing is too far away and blurry to determine the presence of kerb ramps.
The crossing is not clearly visible in the frames to assess its condition or obstructions.
The frames do not provide a clear view of the crossing layout to confirm the need for a refuge island.
